methodologyNotes: Twelve pH meters/testers verified 2026-08-12 directly against manufacturer product pages (Apera Instruments, Hanna Instruments, Bluelab, Milwaukee Instruments EU, Extech, Atlas Scientific) and, where manufacturer pages were unreachable or lacked full specs, corroborating current retail listings (Amazon) for Oakton, VIVOSUN, Hach, and YSI; two seed items could not be verified as real, currently-sold products — Dr.Meter's own site no longer lists a "PH100" (its pH-meter collection now shows only the "PH838" model, with no PH100 found on the manufacturer site, Amazon, or elsewhere) and HoneForest's Amazon catalog contains only a HoneForest-branded TDS/EC meter, no pH tester — so both were dropped and replaced with two verified, real, currently-sold pocket/portable pH meters (Atlas Scientific pH Kit KIT-101P and YSI pH100A) to keep the roster at 12 confirmed SKUs; fields left null (rather than guessed) wherever no fetched source stated that value, including Milwaukee MW102's US price (only its EU distributor price in EUR was found) and several Amazon-only listings (Oakton, Hach) whose spec sheets are not reproduced in the retail listing itself.

products.name: Apera Instruments PH60 Premium Series Waterproof Pocket pH Tester
products.priceNote: Current price on aperainst.com (manufacturer direct, Pocket Testers collection)

specs.electrode_type: Replaceable single-junction ceramic pH probe, lead-free lithium-based glass bulb membrane, Ag/AgCl reference, KCl gel electrolyte
specs.battery_type: 4 x AAA (DC3V), up to 2000 hours continuous use

products.provenance: Apera Instruments' own product page (Pocket Testers collection) confirms all pH range, resolution, accuracy, calibration, ATC, electrode, IP67/floatable rating, battery, and $110.00 price figures directly.

products.name: Apera Instruments PC60 Premium Series Multiparameter (pH/EC/TDS/Salinity/Temp) Pocket Tester
products.priceNote: Current price on aperainst.com (manufacturer direct, Pocket Testers collection)

specs.electrode_type: Replaceable combo probe: lithium glass pH sensor + platinum-black conductivity sensor
specs.battery_type: 4 x AAA (DC3V), up to 1000 hours continuous use

products.provenance: Apera Instruments' own product page confirms pH range/resolution/accuracy (identical pH sub-system to PH60), automatic 1-3 point calibration, ATC, combo pH/EC electrode design, IP67/floatable rating, AAA battery power, and $180.00 price. Conductivity/TDS/salinity ranges are documented separately and out of scope for this pH-meters roster.

products.name: Hanna Instruments HI98107 pHep pH Tester

specs.accuracy_ph: ±0.1 pH at 25°C/77°F (Hanna's own spec table separately lists ±0.2 pH; the narrative accuracy claim ±0.1 pH is used here)
specs.electrode_type: Cloth-junction pH electrode (larger surface area than a standard ceramic junction)
specs.waterproof_rating: Waterproof; rated to RH 100% max, 0 to 50°C
specs.battery_type: 1 x CR2032 3V lithium, approx. 1000 hours continuous use

products.provenance: Hanna Instruments' own HI98107 product page confirms range, resolution, calibration, ATC, cloth-junction electrode, waterproof/RH rating, CR2032 battery/1000-hr life, and $64.99 price. Note: the page's narrative text states ±0.1 pH accuracy while its specifications table elsewhere on the same page lists ±0.2 pH; both figures are Hanna's own, and ±0.1 pH (the headline accuracy claim) is recorded here.

products.name: Hanna Instruments HI98103 Checker pH Tester

specs.electrode_type: HI1271 pH electrode, tapered design, 103mm long x 8mm diameter at sensing end
specs.battery_type: 1 x CR2032 Li-ion, approx. 1000 hours continuous use

products.provenance: Hanna Instruments' own HI98103 Checker product page confirms range, resolution, accuracy, one/two-point auto calibration, the included HI1271 electrode's dimensions, CR2032 battery/1000-hr life, and $46.99 price. ATC and an explicit waterproof/IP rating were not stated anywhere on the fetched page, so both are left blank rather than assumed from the sibling HI98107.

products.name: Milwaukee Instruments MW102 PRO+ 2-in-1 pH and Temperature Meter
products.priceNote: €209.25 on milwaukeeinstruments.eu (EU distributor site); Milwaukee's US site (milwaukeeinst.com) redirects to the EU store and no separate USD consumer price was found, so no price is listed rather than a converted or guessed one

specs.electrode_type: SE220 gel-filled double-junction lab-grade pH electrode + MA831R temperature probe (both included)

products.provenance: Milwaukee Instruments' EU product page confirms pH range, resolution, accuracy, 1/2-point auto calibration, 0-70°C ATC, SE220/MA831R electrode+probe, 9V battery/300-hr life, and the €209.25 price. Operating environment is stated as 0-50°C/max 95% RH but no separate IP/waterproof rating is given, so that field is left blank. Milwaukee's US domain (milwaukeeinst.com) 302-redirects to this same EU site, so no distinct US-market page or USD price exists to cite.

products.name: Extech PH100 ExStik II Waterproof pH Meter
products.priceNote: Current Amazon retail price; extech.com does not display direct consumer pricing on its own product page

specs.electrode_type: Flat-surface electrode (rated for liquids, semi-solids, and solids)

products.provenance: Extech's own PH100 product page confirms range, resolution, accuracy, ATC, flat-surface electrode, IP57 rating, and 4x CR2032 battery configuration; it lists a "CAL alert" feature but never states the number of calibration points, so that field is left blank. products.name: Atlas Scientific pH Kit (KIT-101P) — EZO pH Circuit + Gen 3 Lab Grade Probe
products.priceNote: Current price on atlas-scientific.com (manufacturer direct); volume discounts to $157.99 at 25+ units

specs.calibration_points: Up to 3-point; kit includes 6x 20ml calibration solution pouches (2x pH 4, 2x pH 7, 2x pH 10)
specs.electrode_type: Double-junction Ag/AgCl Gen 3 Lab Grade pH probe (BNC connection to EZO pH circuit board)
specs.battery_type: None — EZO circuit is powered by the host carrier/development board, no internal battery

products.provenance: Atlas Scientific's own pH Kit product page confirms the KIT-101P contents, double-junction Gen 3 probe, included pH 4/7/10 calibration pouches, and $174.99 price. Resolution and accuracy are drawn from the manufacturer's linked Gen 3 Lab Grade pH Probe datasheet (0.001 pH resolution, ±0.002 pH reading accuracy), also hosted on atlas-scientific.com. This is a circuit-board/probe kit rather than a handheld meter, so ATC support (present on the EZO circuit but not stated on the fetched pages) and a waterproof rating are left blank rather than assumed, and battery type reflects that the board has no internal battery.
